[h2]
It’s been two months since the last update, and we know it’s not what we promised.
We faced a major setback, and to overcome it, we had to shift our full focus to "Seducing The Devil" for an extended period.
The new update of "Seducing The Devil" is scheduled to release tomorrow, and the update for "It Was Raining That Night" will follow shortly after. We are almost done with the renders.

We sincerely apologize for the delay. Please be patient with us.[/h2]

[h2]It Was Raining That Night (0.9) is coming out next week!
As mentioned in our other game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2178490/Seducing_The_Devil/]Seducing The Devil[/url], we have streamlined our workflow and are now aiming for quicker releases.
Our latest update was released just 18 days ago, and the next one is going to mark our fastest turnaround time for a new update.[/h2]

notes.title: Please leave a review for the game
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774384/bd0e1190efed5ed726ef1cb3fb3bbc7a4daf2919.jpg[/img]

[h2]We Need Your Support!

Thank you for playing "It Was Raining That Night"—your support means the world to us!

We've poured our hearts into creating this game, and we're thrilled to see it reach so many players. However, less than 0.6% of our players have left a review—60 in total.

Reviews play a crucial role in helping our game get recommended to more people. If you enjoyed playing, we’d greatly appreciate it if you could take a moment to leave a review.

Your feedback not only helps us grow but also allows us to keep improving the experience for you.

Thank you so much for your support![/h2]
